recipes.title: Tofu Thepla with Corn & Rajma Filling and Yogurt Dip
recipes.description: Soft, protein-packed methi theplas made with crumbled tofu, rolled around a spicy corn and rajma filling, dunked in a cool garlicky yogurt dip. Great for lunch boxes and travel.

components.name: Tofu Thepla
ingredients: 200 g firm tofu, finely crumbled or grated
1 cup fresh methi (fenugreek) leaves, chopped — or 2 tbsp kasuri methi
steps: In a bowl, mix the flour, crumbled tofu, methi, ginger–chilli paste, all the spices, sesame, sugar, salt and 2 tbsp oil.
Rub everything together with your fingers first — the tofu releases moisture, so you'll need very little water.
Add water a spoon at a time and knead into a soft, smooth dough. Rest it covered for 10–15 minutes.
Divide into ~10 balls. Roll each thin (about 6–7 inch circle), dusting with flour as needed.
Cook on a hot tava: flip once small bubbles appear, brush a little oil on both sides, and press gently until golden spots form.

components.name: Corn & Rajma Filling
ingredients: 1.5 cups cooked rajma (kidney beans) — canned, rinsed, works fine
steps: Heat oil, add cumin seeds. When they splutter, add garlic and onion and sauté until soft.
Add capsicum and tomato; cook until the tomato breaks down.
Add rajma, corn, chilli powder, garam masala and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
Lightly mash about half the rajma so the filling holds together when rolled.
Turn off heat and finish with chaat masala, lemon juice and coriander.

components.name: Yogurt Dip
steps: Stir in garlic, roasted cumin, black salt, salt and herbs (and cucumber, squeezed dry, if using).

recipes.serving: Spread 2–3 spoons of filling on a warm thepla, roll it up, and dip into the yogurt as you go.
notes: Theplas keep 2–3 days at room temperature and are ideal for travel — store the filling separately in the fridge.
Extra-firm tofu gives the best texture; press it for 10 minutes if it feels watery.
